CREATE TRIGGER `imc_results_nations_gw005_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC002_Results` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group='NATIONS' AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `GW005_IMC_Match_Report` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='national_team' AND a.national_team_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.home_sm_manager_id),NEW.home_sm_manager_id), NEW.away_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group='NATIONS' AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `GW005_IMC_Match_Report` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='national_team' AND a.national_team_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.away_sm_manager_id),NEW.away_sm_manager_id)
